body: a small round seed creature. The body is a plump light brown nut shape, wider at the top, with soft vertical grain lines and a scalloped bottom edge of four blunt rounded points like a tulip bulb, and it has no legs. On top of the body sits a cap of layered green leaves like a wide mushroom cap, drooping over the edge all the way around. From the middle of the cap a short brown stem grows straight up and ends in two small green leaves. A small pair of green leaves grows out of each side of the body as an arm, one pair on each side, at mid height.
front: two round dark dot eyes set wide apart, a small simple smile, and two round pink cheek marks
left: a pure profile from the viewer's left: the round nut body seen edge-on, the leaf cap covering the top, one leaf arm pointing at the viewer, no face visible
back: the plain back of the nut body: no eyes and no mouth at all, only the bark grain lines, the leaf cap, the stem and the two leaf arms seen from behind
right: a pure profile from the viewer's right: the round nut body seen edge-on, the leaf cap covering the top, one leaf arm pointing at the viewer, no face visible
